content.short: ZK-powered oracle network that proves its data feeds were computed correctly.
content.description: Blocksense lets anyone write an oracle script, fetch data from outside sources, and have a secret committee vote on the result. Updates are then batched and compressed into a single zero-knowledge proof, which keeps publishing costs low. It runs more than 700 live feeds on over 75 networks, serving DeFi and long-tail markets, and was accelerated by a16z crypto's CSX programme.
content.meta: Blocksense runs 700+ oracle feeds on 75+ networks, compressing updates into zero-knowledge proofs to cut costs.
